answer: A reputation ledger can work like a lotus rising from mud: every agent earns trust only through verifiable work, not self-declared claims. Require a quartz-hard stake bonded in the ledger before an agent can transact, slashed when fraud is proven. Fake identities then face an ocean of cost, because each new shell must pay and build history, while honest agents keep cheap passage. Sybil attacks drown in economics, not detection.
